name: MatLab App Example
summary: Template MATLAB brainlife.io App that resamples a T1-weighted NIfTI image to a new voxel resolution; an example for App developers, not an analysis tool.
description: Example code showing how a MATLAB App reads config.json and processes data: it reslices the T1w image to the resolution in outres with reslice_nii. Use it as a starting point for writing Apps. As written, main.m loads config.json.example instead of config.json and no output datatype is registered, so it is not meant for production use.

parameters.description: Target voxel size in mm, as three comma-separated values (x,y,z).
